gates.name: Concrete floor + EMA21 breakout
gates.detail: floor[Fib 0.5@89.74; horizontal support (15 touches)] | bounce=True | confirm[RSI-Div] | close 91.33 < EMA21 91.65 | bounce_date=2026-08-21

gates.name: Early entry (Path E)
gates.detail: floor[Fib 0.5@89.74; horizontal support (15 touches)] | confirm[RSI-Div] | price/EMA21 = 0.997 (band 0.85-1.15) | ELIGIBLE — UNCONFIRMED entry, requires LLM event anchor + 5-session time stop
gates.criterion: floor + bounce + (RSI-Div OR >=1.5x vol) + 0.85 <= price/EMA21 <= 1.15, WITHOUT the EMA21 reclaim; requires LLM event anchor + time stop

gates.name: Relative Strength
gates.detail: A) red day 2026-07-29 -1.54% -> stock 0.82% [PASS] | B) 20d stock -1.5% vs SPY +3.4% = excess -4.9% [fail] | passed_via=red-day
gates.criterion: red-day test OR 20d excess return >= +2% vs SPY

gates.name: Risk geometry (stop distance)

gates.name: Rule-of-40 / RPO decoupling
gates.detail: AI: rev growth + margin > 40%? RPO growing YoY? document price/perf decoupling (cite 10-Q/10-K)
gates.criterion: Rule of 40 true AND RPO up YoY

gates.name: Insider buying (Form 4)
gates.detail: AI: search FRESH Form 4 insider BUYS only (NOT 13F)

gates.name: Disruption test
gates.detail: AI: direct threat=STRONG SELL | adapting w/ AI=BUY⚠️ | infra/data moat=clean

gates.name: Disruption quality (WARN test)
gates.detail: AI: a ⚠️ WARN-level disruption is ONLY acceptable while the fundamentals are ACCELERATING. Active competitive displacement + DECELERATING growth = HARD REJECT (do not log, do not hold). Cite the two most recent quarters of the key growth metric and state accelerating/decelerating. Archetype: ISRG (Hugo + Ottava entering AND procedure growth decelerating) = reject; BMY (Eliquis cliff BUT growth portfolio accelerating) and LMT (drone threat BUT record backlog) = keep.

gates.name: Bounce catalyst anchor (Path E)
gates.detail: AI: the reversal started on bounce_date=2026-08-21 (pivot low 89.16). Find what happened WITHIN 3 SESSIONS of that date: earnings / guidance / a company disclosure / a regulatory or contract event. A bounce anchored to a dated, cited event is a re-rating; a bounce anchored to nothing is mean-reversion noise. MANDATORY — this ticker is a PATH E (unconfirmed, pre-EMA21) candidate: NO cited dated event => REFUSE the entry.
gates.criterion: Path E requires a dated, cited event within 3 sessions of bounce_date

gates.name: Devil's advocate
gates.detail: AI MUST write 2 concrete, evidenced bear reasons. NO OUTPUT without it.

gates.name: Data healing (PEG/FCF)
gates.detail: AI: if survivor has SKIP on PEG/FCF, web-fetch real value. Fwd PEG; Yahoo>SeekingAlpha>StockAnalysis; tag '(AI-healed, source, date)'; never guess; survivors only.
gates.criterion: heal SKIP PEG/FCF with cited value
